_comment: True [width_m, height_m] of the drawn view. When both real dimensions are known, build-silhouettes.mjs overrides the traced aspect with the real one (the renderer stretches via preserveAspectRatio=none). Generated silhouettes are usually drawn a bit too tall (or, occasionally, in the wrong orientation entirely); this corrects both. Second dimension is a reasonable real-world estimate where the pool only tracks one axis.
